odin_ranges.metric_definition: Year-over-year reduction in wheat import value from Orvan post-expiration
odin_ranges.denominator: Prior year (2025) corresponding monthly import values
assumptions: Low bound reflects post-expiration loss across October-December 2026; high bound includes September 2026.
odin_ranges.uncertainty_note: Calculated directly from Tier-1 official trade tables (ORV-0009). The lower bound excludes September 2026 while the upper bound includes it.

odin_ranges.metric_definition: Year-over-year reduction in maize import value from Orvan post-expiration
odin_ranges.denominator: Prior year (2025) corresponding monthly import values
assumptions: Low bound captures Nov-Dec 2026 post delayed contract clearance; high bound captures Oct-Dec 2026.
odin_ranges.uncertainty_note: Calculated directly from Tier-1 official trade tables (ORV-0030). Delayed delivery terms cushioned October volume, making Nov-Dec the post-clearance core deficit.
